At scaffold time the complete displayed §15.2 and §15.3 arguments and exercise statements over the cited range were read. During Step 3b the full PDF was re-fetched (7,688,582 bytes; SHA-256 57ce73e13c3fd56c6720613aa62b711c996abcd3711c28c995ea3b24d918827b); the exact text of §§6.3.9, 6.4.1 and Definition 6.4.4 (pp. 140–142), Exercise 6.4.M (p. 144), Exercise and Important Definition 14.1.G (p. 308), and §20.4.1 was inspected. Definition 6.4.4 gives the stalkwise condition and warns that it is not affine-local; Exercise 6.4.M and 14.1.G are prompts only and are not treated as proofs. Section 20.4.1 defines divisor degree for nonsingular projective curves; the broader curve formula is stated as a definition and imports no theorem from that narrower setting. The Picard-group proof is supplied locally.
